title: Natural polymorphism of ZmICE1 contributes to amino acid metabolism that impacts cold tolerance in maize
genotypes: wild type and zmice1-1 mutant (inbred background NR); ZmICE1-GFP transgenic seedlings used for ChIP-seq with WT as negative control; no tolerance claim for these lines
growth_system: grown at 25 °C for 2 weeks; chamber type, substrate and photoperiod NR
bio_reps: NR (12 RNA-seq runs would fit 2 genotypes x 2 temperatures x 3 reps, unconfirmed)
n_libraries: 12 RNA-seq (+ 2 ChIP-seq) per ENA run summary supplied by caller
other_omics: metabolomics (amino acids; MetaboLights MTBLS4404); ChIP-seq of ZmICE1-GFP (in PRJNA779257); physiology
key_finding: ZmICE1 regulates COR genes and represses Asn synthetase genes under cold; ZmICE1 promoter variation (ZmMYB39 binding) affects cold tolerance across inbreds.
source_of_details: abstract + web search (publisher full text not accessible; no PMC)
notes: Dataset is the paper's own: Data availability states RNA-seq and ChIP-seq data are in SRA under PRJNA779257 (read from a web-search summary of the publisher page, not from full text). Design (WT vs zmice1-1 at 25 C vs 4 C 12 h; 2,933 cold-responsive genes in WT) also from web-search summary of the Nature Plants page; replicates, background, tissue and platform not confirmed. Same CAU lab as Zeng2021 and Zeng2024.

title: Genetic variation in the aquaporin TONOPLAST INTRINSIC PROTEIN 4;3 modulates maize cold tolerance
genotypes: LH244 (wild type) and TIP4;3-overexpressing transgenic line (LH244 background; line ID for RNA-seq NR); CRISPR knockouts and 195-inbred panel used only for phenotypes and RT-qPCR
tissue: leaves (pool of leaves from 3 plants per sample)
growth_system: pots with plant ash:vermiculite:Pindstrup soil (3:1:1) at 25 °C, 16 h light/8 h dark; chamber vs greenhouse NR
bio_reps: 2 (Methods: two independent biological replicates; Results text says three independent experiments)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 6000 (as stated); layout NR; reads mapped to B73 v4 with HISAT2
accession: PRJNA1054219 (candidate, ownership unconfirmed: no accession in PMC text)
other_omics: physiology (leaf injury, stomatal conductance, ROS); association analysis; promoter methylation
key_finding: TIP4;3 attenuates cold tolerance; 2,620 cold DEGs in WT, 2,192 genes affected by TIP4;3; promoter transposon insertion represses TIP4;3.
notes: No data availability statement or accession in the retrieved PMC text. ENA PRJNA1054219 ('The transcriptome sequencing of ZmTIP4', 8 RNA-seq runs) matches the design exactly (8 libraries = 2 genotypes x 2 temperatures x 2 reps), so it is very likely the paper's own, but this is inferred, not stated. Same CAU lab as Zeng2021 (ZmRR1) and Jiang2022.

title: Gene regulatory effects of a large chromosomal inversion in highland maize
genotypes: B73-background families (5 backcrosses to B73, then selfed) segregating for the highland Inv4m inversion haplotype (high vs low) from two highland landrace donors, PT and Mi21; 2 families x 2 homozygous haplotypes; highland material, Inv4m introgressed from Zea mays ssp. mexicana (flag teosinte-derived)
tissue: 9 tissues: V1 leaf and primary root; V3 primary root, SAM, leaf sheath, leaf base, leaf tip, S2 leaf base, S2 leaf tip
growth_system: UC Davis controlled-environment growth chambers; pots (3:1 Sunshine Mix #1:sand), 1x Hoagland every other day; 12 h light; sampled 2-4 h after simulated sunrise; chambers switched between experimental replicates
cold_treatments: 22 °C day / 11 °C night (simulated Mexican highlands), applied from sowing (chronic cool growth, emergence about 9 d)
control_temperature: 32 °C day / 22 °C night (simulated lowlands; emergence about 4 d)
other_factors: Inv4m haplotype; donor family; 9 tissues; two experimental replicates
timepoints_duration: chronic growth temperature until V1/V3; single sampling per plant
bio_reps: 3 per tissue x temperature x family x haplotype in each of 2 experimental replicates
n_libraries: 432 planned (9 tissues x 2 temperatures x 2 families x 2 haplotypes x 3 reps x 2 experimental reps); 379 analysed after excluding 53 with <100,000 reads; 346 files deposited
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq X, strand-specific mRNA-seq (BRaD-seq), 96-plex per lane, mean 4.2 M reads per sample; read length NR
other_omics: GBS genotyping; seedling emergence phenotypes; previously published landrace WGS used for divergence
key_finding: Highland Inv4m haplotype alters expression across 9 tissues in cool and warm chambers; photosynthesis genes up under cool in S2 leaf.
source_of_details: PMC full text + publisher page (Data availability statement)
notes: BORDERLINE fit: chronic cool vs warm growth temperature (22/11 vs 32/22 C), not acute chilling; authors call it 'cold' vs 'warm'. Dataset is the paper's own: PLOS Data availability says 'All 346 files are available from the SRA database (PRJNA640392)'. Deposited file count (346) differs from the 379 analysed samples.
